LAREDO, Texas — Eliseo Arredondo III was arrested early Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 5:11 a.m., and booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged felony drug charges, including a second-degree felony count of possession of a controlled substance in Penalty Group 2, 4 grams to under 400 grams, according to Webb County booking records reviewed Thursday.

The records also show a second alleged charge: possession of a controlled substance in Penalty Group 1/1-B, under 1 gram — a state jail felony. No arresting agency was listed in the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956.

No bond had been set on either charge as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956.

A second-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to 20 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000. A state jail felony carries 180 days to two years in state jail and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Eliseo Arredondo III is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.

Webb Watch 956
